payload.title: Holocene Ice Analysis
payload.description: This workflow analyzes climate dynamics during the Holocene using ice core records from Greenland and Antarctica. It employs proxies for temperature, such as oxygen and hydrogen isotope data, to infer past climate conditions. The workflow utilizes various scientific computing libraries to process and visualize the data, focusing on specific indices within the datasets.
